import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterModule } from '@angular/router'; import { AdminService, User } from './admin.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-edit-user', templateUrl: './edit-user.component.html', styleUrls: ['./edit-user.component.css'] }) export class EditUserComponent implements OnInit { user: User = { name: '', username: '', email: '', roles: [] }; errorMessage: string | null = null; constructor( private route: ActivatedRoute, private adminService: AdminService, private router: Router ) { } ngOnInit(): void { const userId = +this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')!; this.adminService.getUser(userId).subscribe({ next: (user) => { this.user = { ...user }; }, error: (err) => { console.error('Failed to load user:', err); this.errorMessage = 'Failed to load user details.'; } }); } saveUser(): void { this.adminService.updateUser(this.user).subscribe({ next: () => { this.router.navigate(['/admin']); }, error: (err) => { console.error('Failed to update user:', err); this.errorMessage = 'Failed to update user.'; } }); } }
